name: Toujou Kanon
source:
Kanon is a very shy girl who's partnered with Yuuhei during naked week training. She's impressed with how kind and considerate Chris is to his partners Alice and Sana. Her biggest fear is being raped during naked week and hopes Chris can help rescue her when she's in need.

She is voiced only in the Sana Append where she takes the role of sub-heroine to Sana and Alice.
